title: src/outline.rs: Outline data model and emptiness check

sections.title: Stored geometry and raster metadata
sections.prose: `Outline` is a public record for flattened contour geometry: its point coordinates are represented by `OutlinePoint`, while endpoint indices, tag bytes, dropout controls, fill flags, and pixel-aligned bounds remain separate fields. This file also defines internal numeric outline settings; no consuming operation for those settings appears here.
sections.spokenText: The file models flattened contour geometry alongside its tags, raster controls, fill settings, and bitmap bounds. It also declares a small set of internal numeric settings.

claims.prose: The public `Outline` record stores its contour count in `n_contours`, contour endpoint indices in `contours`, and flattened geometry in `points` as `OutlinePoint` values.
Each `OutlinePoint` has 26.6 integer coordinates named `x` and `y`, plus an `on_curve` boolean indicating its curve tag.

`tags` can store exact public FreeType tag bytes when a loader has them; an empty `tags` vector means curve tags are derived from `OutlinePoint::on_curve`. `contour_dropouts` stores per-contour dropout controls, and an empty vector means the control is derived from `flags`.
The `flags` field stores outline flags, while `cbox_x_min`, `cbox_y_min`, `cbox_x_max`, and `cbox_y_max` store pixel-aligned bounds used to size the target bitmap.

The file defines crate-visible `u32` constants named `OUTLINE_HIGH_PRECISION`, `OUTLINE_SINGLE_PASS`, `OUTLINE_REVERSE_FILL`, `OUTLINE_IGNORE_DROPOUTS`, `OUTLINE_SMART_DROPOUTS`, `OUTLINE_INCLUDE_STUBS`, and `OUTLINE_OVERLAP`, each with a fixed hexadecimal value; no operation consuming these constants appears in this file.

sections.title: When `is_empty` returns true
sections.prose: `Outline::is_empty` checks two conditions joined by OR: no stored points, or a contour count of zero. Either condition is enough, so disagreement between the fields does not prevent a true result. The method returns false only when points are present and the contour count is nonzero; its body shows no field update or error result.
sections.spokenText: The check returns true if there are no stored points or if the contour count is zero. Either mismatch is enough, and when neither condition holds it returns false; the method only borrows the outline.

claims.prose: `Outline::is_empty` returns true when `points.is_empty()` or `n_contours == 0`; either condition alone is sufficient. Thus, empty `points` with nonzero `n_contours`, and nonempty `points` with zero `n_contours`, both produce true. It returns false only when `points` is nonempty and `n_contours` is nonzero. The method takes `&self` and returns `bool`; its body shows no field write or error result, so it does not repair disagreement.
